note: What production was ACTUALLY running when this branch was cut, verified by downloading each deployed function with `supabase functions download`, hashing every file with `git hash-object --no-filters`, and confirming the blob exists in this repository. Recorded separately from config/edge-function-manifest.json because that manifest describes the REPOSITORY, and once the repository moves ahead of production a passing parity gate no longer means 'repo equals production'. This file is what makes the difference legible.
aheadOfProductionRule: The repository MAY move ahead of production, but only while every behavioural change it adds is behind a flag that defaults off. That is what makes an un-deployed divergence safe: a deploy from this checkout changes no behaviour until an operator turns something on. __tests__/deployedBaselineDivergence.test.js enforces it.
